title: Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Amendment Amending Ordinance 2000

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Amendment Amending Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XI OF 2000
SINDH AGRICULTURAL
INCOME TAX (AMENDMENT) AMENDING ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XI OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 12th October, 2000]
No. S.LEGIS.1/(II)/2000, dated
12-10-2000. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sndh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Agricultural
Income tax (Amendment) Amending Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Amendment Amending Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Amendment of section 1 of Sindh Ordinance II of 2000

ORDINANCE XI OF 2000
SINDH AGRICULTURAL
INCOME TAX (AMENDMENT) AMENDING ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XI OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 12th October, 2000]
No. S.LEGIS.1/(II)/2000, dated
12-10-2000. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sndh is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 1 of
Sindh Ordinance II of 2000.---In the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2000 (Sindh Ordinance No. II of 2000), in section 1, in
subsection (2) after the word "once" the words, comma and figure
"and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from Kharif, 1999"
shall be added and shall be deemed always to have been so added.
